cohort: Pregnant women in Norrbotten County in northern Sweden
finding: While self-selection into the NICE birth cohort study was evident for some lifestyle and socioeconomic factors, it did not appear to influence pregnancy outcomes or the effects of certain lifestyle factors on these outcomes.
mod_finding: While the study found no differences in mode of delivery, gestational age at delivery, birth weight, or APGAR score between participants and non-participants, self-selection to the NICE study was evident in some factors related to lifestyle and socioeconomic characteristics.
